fields.Name: Record Cloning
fields.Description: Root authorization for all record cloning operations. Users or roles must hold this authorization (or a descendant) to plan or execute record clones.

fields.Name: Clone Records
fields.Description: Grants permission to execute record clone operations. Evaluated with ancestors; holders pass all schema-level checks unless explicitly restricted.

fields.Name: Clone Records in Platform Schema
fields.Description: Permits cloning records belonging to core platform entities in the __mj schema.

fields.Name: Clone Records in Custom Schemas
fields.Description: Permits cloning records belonging to entities in custom/application schemas.

fields.Name: Clone Records: Fire Hooks
fields.Description: Change whether Entity Actions and Entity AI Actions run during a clone, overriding the entity's clone configuration (Entity Actions run by default; AI Actions are suppressed). A sibling of Clone Records, so holding Clone Records does not grant it.

fields.Name: Clone Records: Batch
fields.Description: Clone several records in one request (the Clone Records action). A sibling of Clone Records, so holding Clone Records does not grant it.

fields.Name: Record Changes: Annotate
fields.Description: Permits updating the Comments column on existing RecordChange rows to annotate history and explain past edits.

fields.Name: Manage Authorizations
fields.Description: Root authorization for managing the authorization hierarchy, role mappings, and security policies.

fields.Name: Clone Records: Override Scope
fields.Description: Permits widening a clone beyond the entity's configured scope for one request: raising MaxDepth or MaxRecords, or including soft links, IS-A subtypes or a hierarchy subtree the configuration leaves out. Narrowing scope never needs it.
